title: Tutorials for Learning VS Code in GitHub Codespaces
text: core tutorials introduce students VS Code integrated development environment. VS Code Scripts (“01-code”). Introduce students VS Code writing R code simple scripts. VS Code Quarto (“02-quarto”). Demonstrate tricks working R code using VS Code, also explain Quarto documents. Terminal (“03-terminal”). Teach command line. VS Code GitHub Introduction (“04-github-1”). Explain basics Git GitHub, mostly context VS Code. VS Code GitHub Advanced (“05-github-2”). Provide practice working Git/GitHub, including details use GitHub Pages. Quarto Websites Introduction (“06-websites-1”). Demonstrate basics website construction using Quarto projects. Quarto Websites Advanced (“07-websites-2”). Practice Quarto websites, focus splitting data analysis tasks separate files. R Data Science Analyzing US Census Data tutorials now live separate misc.tutorials package.
